title: CPU interval accounting
responsibility: Converts two CPU readings into machine use and process groups, assigning descendants to their nearest recognized owner without counting lifetime CPU for new processes.

inputs.name: cpuMetrics.before
inputs.description: Earlier timestamp, cumulative machine counters and process CPU totals in milliseconds.

inputs.name: cpuMetrics.after
inputs.description: Later timestamp, machine counters, logical core count and current process list used to attribute interval CPU.

outputs.name: cpuMetrics
outputs.description: Available snapshot with current sampling time, elapsed interval, machine utilization or null when counters do not advance, Codex/Harness/agent group totals and agents sorted by core utilization. New processes and counter decreases contribute zero elapsed CPU.
